status: D-025 (5 Sep 2026): exact Kind identities, inward paths, transformative forms, alloy refinements and equipment capabilities; see docs/systems/foundry-mutations.md

ingot_metals.design_purpose: The default: every milestone's ingot is cast in iron and reads its backing and pairs one cell out, as the plate always has.

Era two's alloy. Re-casting an ingot in it at the forge widens its reach to two cells: a bronze Ember pairs with a Reach across a gap, a bronze Frost is backed by a Frost two cells down. The number never changes (D-019's refinement is reach, not size).
Era three's alloy: three cells, the whole plate. Steel needs iron forever (smelt_steel), so old metal never becomes trash.

design_purpose_metals: Ingots retain their small base reading. Re-casting at the built forge costs the alloy allowed by the era and extends backing/pair reach. A direct support also gains all support_only refinements whose metal requirement it meets: bronze adds mastery/control/recovery and steel adds another capability. Bronze Reach adds projectile pierce and steel adds a fork, including on a melee skill transformed into a travelling wave. Supports remain adjacent and flow never jumps gaps.

kinds.design_purpose: No base: a catalyst's whole worth is the forms it works supports into. Its element will pick its own forms (an 'augment fire', owner 4 Sep 2026) when the forms table narrows by kind.
No base; the offence family's forms. Its own transformations wait for the by-kind narrowing.
The Vanguard of armour: +4 armour flows to the sheet while a chain leads to a skill. Scaling defence is gear's job; this is small and flat.
The Vanguard of resistances: +5 to fire and cold resistance while the flow holds. The Vanguard of dodge waits for a dodge stat.
The Marrow of life: +6 life while the flow holds. The Marrows of leech and recoup wait for those stats; the family's forms wait for slice 9.

The Quicksilver of hands: +4% cooldown recovery for attacks and spells while the flow holds. The Quicksilvers of move speed, attack speed and cast speed wait for those stats to be told apart; the family's forms wait for slice 9.
Works Reach into Throughline (+1 pierce) and Edge into Barbed Flight (+15 bleed buildup) for projectile skills. Common Catalyst forms still apply. An aimed gear craft favours projectile modifiers.
Works Edge into Concussion (+0.15 seconds stagger) and Reach into Follow Through (+0.5 metres shove) for attacks. Common Catalyst forms still apply. An aimed gear craft favours physical modifiers.
While its chain reaches a skill, landed hits restore 0.5 life. It also works adjacent supports into the Marrow family forms. Aimed gear crafts favour life modifiers.
While its chain reaches a skill, attacks recover 8% faster; spells do not. It also works supports into Quicksilver forms. Aimed gear crafts favour speed modifiers.
While its chain reaches a skill, spells recover 8% faster; attacks do not. It also works supports into Quicksilver forms. Aimed gear crafts favour speed modifiers.

design_purpose_kinds: D-025: only skills occupy sockets. Kinds rest at depth two or greater and conduct through occupied orthogonal cells of strictly decreasing distance to a socket. Every branch reaching a laid tablet transforms every traversed ingot using the exact Kind identity. Reconvergence does not multiply a reading; another Kind carries the upstream identity and adds its own operation. Explicit upstream_kind rules define ordered additions. Setting/lifting uses existing ownership and re-forging costs. Forms expose resolved names without changing persistent ingot IDs.

forms.description: The first unlit target struck carries a 0.9-second ember fuse. It then receives 65 ignite buildup, scaled by ignition gear; no extra hit damage. One fuse per cast, at most one every 2.4 seconds. A target already burning when the fuse ends receives nothing. Adds 45 ignite buildup to the main hit.

Hit an already chilled enemy to release a 1.6 m steam puff that briefly interrupts nearby enemies without extra damage. At most one puff every 1.5 seconds across your skills; bosses receive a quarter-length stagger. Adds 45 ignite and 20 chill buildup; Frost keeps its ordinary damage support.

Hit a burning or bleeding enemy to cut a narrow cinder seam 3 m behind them. After 0.25 seconds it flashes once for 8% of base hit as fire damage, excluding the original target. Line up the pack; cover blocks it. One seam per cast, at most one every 1.4 seconds. Adds 45 ignite and 20 bleed buildup to the main hit.

Hit a burning enemy to send one visible spark to the nearest unlit enemy within 4.5 m before reach and proliferation gear. It carries 35 ignite buildup, no hit damage, and never jumps again. Cover blocks its travel. One spark per cast, at most one every 1.5 seconds. Adds 45 ignite buildup to the main hit.

Starting a burn sheds a warm cinder at the target. Move within 1.4 m to collect 3 life before it fades after 6 seconds. At most one cinder every 2 seconds across your skills. Adds 45 ignite buildup; the Vigour support keeps its ordinary recovery.

Hit a burning enemy to heat your plate for 2.5 seconds. Your next damaging enemy hit releases a 2.4 m ring that pushes nearby enemies back 0.9 m; bosses move one quarter as far. No added damage or absorption. At most one charge every 3 seconds. Adds 45 ignite buildup; Plate keeps its ordinary cast armour.

Starting a burn removes one affliction: root first, then harry, then mark. If clear, gain a 3-second Cautery ward that prevents the next one of those afflictions, while its hit still deals damage. At most once every 3 seconds; never stacks charges. Adds 45 ignite buildup; Ward keeps its ordinary mitigation.

Follow-up hits release up to 0.45 seconds of an existing burn immediately, spending that remaining burn time. At most once per target each second; adds no second burn. Adds 45 ignite buildup; the Haste support keeps its ordinary recovery.

Hit a burning enemy to move up to 0.6 seconds of its remaining burn into a 1.8 m ember bed. Two small pulses share that stored fire damage; the original burn loses exactly the time taken. One bed per cast, at most every 3 seconds. Adds 20 ignite buildup to the main hit.

Hit a chilled enemy to hold its chill buildup against decay for 1.2 seconds. This does not prolong a freeze or add damage. One held reservoir per cast, at most every 3 seconds. Adds 20 chill buildup to the main hit.

Hit a bleeding enemy to preserve up to 1 second of its wound while it stands still. Both bleed time and damage wait, then resume when it moves or the stored second is spent. Each wound can be preserved once. Adds 20 bleed buildup to the main hit.

The first target struck leaves a 1.8 m afterfield for 3.2 seconds. The first newcomer entering it triggers one 12% echo of the skill's native hit. Enemies already inside when it formed are excluded. No buildup or child attacks. At most one field every 3 seconds.

Casting marks a 1.8 m lifebed where you stood for 3.2 seconds. Leave it and return before it fades to recover 3 life once. It never heals just for standing still. At most one bed every 3 seconds; healing gear applies.

Casting leaves a 1.8 m seal for 3.2 seconds. The first enemy entering it from outside is pushed back 0.9 m; enemies already inside are ignored. Bosses move one quarter as far. One charge, no damage, at most one seal every 3 seconds.
A direct-hit kill leaves a 1.8 m sanctuary at the victim for 3.2 seconds. It catches one incoming enemy projectile. No reflection or extra attack; one sanctuary every 3 seconds.

After casting this skill, use a different skill within 3.2 seconds to recover 0.3 seconds of the first skill's remaining cooldown. Repeats and linked casts cannot spend or create this memory. One stored memory every 3 seconds.
Stand in your furnace brace to absorb part of one enemy hit; the spent brace vents a delayed heat burst.
Plant a rime boundary. Newcomers crossing it are chilled and briefly interrupted; enemies already inside are untouched.
Arm a riposte. After a nearby enemy hurts you, strike that same attacker before the counter expires.
Place a broad brace ahead of you. Enemies entering its narrow crossbar are pushed away, opening room to retreat.
Take damage inside the living brace, then remain there without another hit to recover a small portion. Leaving forfeits it.
Settle into your casting position to build a small damage-absorption pool. Moving breaks the stance.
Plant a guardpost, then strike an enemy to designate it. Its hits are weaker while you remain at your post.
Brace briefly in your casting direction. Catch a frontal enemy hit to absorb damage and recover part of your dash cooldown.
Catch one shot in an ember veil. The impact becomes a short visible fuse before bursting; lure enemies into it.
Send an expanding rime front outward. Its one intercepted shot releases a local chill burst at the crossing.
Your first damaging contact sets a narrow tripwire halfway to that enemy. One crossing shot snaps it into a cutting line.
Project a wide screen ahead of you, stopping at cover. It catches one shot travelling toward its front; flanking shots pass.
Catch one shot, then approach its impact to collect the living mote. Healing waits for collection.
Catch one shot in an iron veil. Carry its remnant as a shell that absorbs part of your next melee hit.
Prepare a personal emergency ward. It arms when your life falls below forty percent and catches one shot while following you.
Leave your casting position to arm a decoy veil. A shot caught behind you restores part of your dash cooldown.
A direct-hit kill leaves a seed. After 0.7 seconds, approach within 1.2 metres to collect 2.5 life once.
Hit an already chilled enemy, then stand within 2 metres of it for 1 second to draw 2.5 life; movement resets the hold.
A real hit marks an already bleeding enemy for 5 seconds. A direct-hit execution within 4 clear metres returns 2.5 life once.
A direct-hit kill starts a harvest. A second nearby direct kill ripens it; approach within 1.2 metres to collect 2.5 life.
A landed hit below half life stores 2.5 recovery. Avoid incoming enemy damage for 2 seconds to receive it; another hit resets that wait.
A landed hit readies recoup. After the next damaging enemy hit, hold that position for 1 second to recover up to 2.5 life, limited by half the damage taken.
A direct kill leaves a harbour. Stay near it with no living enemy in its 3-metre clear space for 0.8 seconds to collect 2.5 life.
A direct kill releases a fleeing pod. Chase it and collect 2.5 life before it expires; remaining at your original position pays nothing.
After a damaging hit, move away to draw one short fire seam. Enemies crossing it take one fire cut; the original victim is excluded.
Cast, then leave your footprint. It chills the first pursuer entering the abandoned space once.
Land a hit, then circle to the opposite side of that enemy for one physical aftercut.
Cast, move away, then hit a distant enemy to pull it toward the old casting position once. Bosses move less.
After a damaging hit, leave its attacking position to recover a little life once.
Cast and retreat; the next nearby enemy that damages you is shoved away once. Bosses move less.
After casting, suffer a hit and recast this skill to clear one root, harry or mark, in that order.
Recast this skill from a new position to discharge one echo at the previous casting position. It uses the skill's damage type; movement skills gain no damage.
First contact sends a small fire lance onward through the rear rank. The original victim is excluded; cover stops the travelling lance.
First contact sights a narrow line behind the victim; after a short warning its farthest visible enemy receives chill. No extra hit damage.
First contact sends a cutting return toward your original position. It cuts intervening enemies once, excluding the struck victim; movement changes the return lane.
Pierce two different enemies with the same cast to flash the line between them. The two anchors are excluded; other enemies in that narrow line take one small physical hit.
First contact opens a short blood thread. Hit another enemy behind it along the same lane to recover life once; the return needs clear cover.
Hit a frontal guard to break its stance and drive it back. Open the guard with one hit, then exploit the short opening; bosses receive reduced control.
Hit a warded enemy to send a visible needle toward its protecting warden. On arrival it briefly interrupts that warden, dropping its aura; cover can stop the needle.
Hit one enemy, then use a new cast on a different enemy at least two metres away to recover some of this skill cooldown. One short memory; no reward for repeatedly hitting the same target.
First contact marks a delayed fire crescent behind the victim. The crescent hits the rear half of the pack once, excluding the original victim; the skill keeps its original delivery.
Impact an already chilled enemy to break the pack apart with a harmless outward shove. Bosses move less; this neither freezes nor adds a damage packet.
A first hit marks a victim. Strike it again with a different real cast during the short window to discharge one small physical concussion and interrupt its attack.
First contact launches an expanding shock ring. It reaches new enemies over time and hits each once, excluding the first victim; cover blocks its advance to recipients.
Hit an enemy below 35% life to leave a delayed physical fracture at that position. Draw its neighbours into the marked spot for one small finishing burst.
Stand still briefly before landing a hit to mark an anvil fall. After a visible delay it strikes that fixed position and shoves survivors; enemies can leave the mark.
Hit a protected enemy to mark its warden position. After a warning the mark interrupts warding enemies inside it; moving out or intervening cover defeats it.
First contact arms a short-lived snap charge at the target position. Approach within one metre to detonate it once; staying at range lets it expire.
Hit an already burning enemy and maintain a clear tether for 0.8 seconds. A cinder then travels back, restoring 2.5 life only on arrival.
A hit on an already chilled enemy stores 2.5 life. Spend the charge by successfully casting a movement skill within 5 seconds.
Land three separate real casts on the same bleeding enemy within 5 seconds to drink 2.5 life once.
Hit from at least 4 metres, keep a clear tether for 1 second, then retreat another metre to draw 2.5 life; closing in breaks it.
Sample two different living enemies with separate real casts. Your next successful real cast spends the reservoir for 2.5 life.
A successful cast braces its position. Take an enemy hit there, then counterhit that actual attacker to recover up to 2.5 life, limited by half the damage taken.
While rooted, harried or marked, land a real hit to bank 2.5 life. Recovery arrives only after all those captured afflictions clear; it does not cleanse them.
Land a real hit, then hit with a different real skill within 2 seconds to drink 2.5 life. Repeating the same skill pays nothing.
Hit an enemy, then hit it again while it is already burning to burst behind it. The original victim takes no burst hit. Attacks only.
Hit one enemy, then a different enemy to send a returning chill mote to the first. The mote must arrive. Attacks only.
Land a second hit on the same enemy between 0.3 and 1.2 seconds after the first for one physical aftercut. Attacks only.
Hit two different enemies to cut the short line between their contact positions once. Both original targets are excluded. Attacks only.
Land three hits from separate casts without taking damage to recover life. Being hit breaks the sequence. Attacks only.
Hold your position between two damaging attacks at least 0.6 seconds apart to gain brief armour. Moving breaks the brace.
After casting, answer an enemy that damages you with a landed hit to interrupt it and clear one control. Boss interruption is shorter. Attacks only.
Cast this attack from three distinct positions to recover a little of the longest movement cooldown. Echoes do not count.
A damaging spell hit leaves a delayed fire burst. Only enemies that arrive after the mark appeared can be hit.
A damaging spell hit schedules one delayed chill ring at your attacking-side footprint. Reposition to lead pursuers into it.
A damaging spell hit draws one delayed physical return cut along the short line back toward you. The initial victim is excluded.
A damaging spell hit leaves a delayed hollow ring in the spell's damage type. Enemies in its centre are safe.
A spell kill leaves a life mote. Cast a different spell to draw it home; healing waits for arrival and cover can block it.
Hold position through a spell's short afterglow to gain brief armour. Moving before it settles cancels it.
A spell leaves a delayed screen at its old casting position. Once active it intercepts one hostile projectile.
A spell leaves a slowly drifting metronome. Meet it after it starts moving and cast a spell there to recover some of that new cast's cooldown.
Ignite becomes Smoulder: one fire burn also slows movement by 25%. Separate chill buildup can freeze; fire burn and cold buildup gear both matter. Death spread carries Smoulder.

The first enemy struck sends an expanding ring of frost out to 2 m over 0.8 seconds. Each visible enemy it reaches receives 20 chill once, without extra hit damage. One ring per cast, at most one every 2 seconds. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Hit a chilled enemy to open two short ice cuts to its sides. After 0.2 seconds they deal 6% of base hit as cold to enemies beside the target, never the target itself. One pair per cast, at most every 2 seconds. Adds 20 bleed buildup to the main hit. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Hit a chilled enemy to leave a 1.7 m mist for 2.4 seconds. Enemy shots crossing it become frostbitten and travel 40% slower for the rest of their flight. Each shot slows only once. One mist per cast, at most every 2 seconds; no added damage. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Hit a chilled enemy to draw a thin ice skin for 2.5 seconds. It absorbs up to 3 damage from the next damaging enemy hit after your armour and resistances, then breaks. One skin every 3 seconds; charges never stack. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Hit a chilled enemy to bind its feet for 0.45 seconds. It can still attack, but cannot walk. Bosses instead lose 25% movement; chill immunity prevents the bind. One bind per cast, at most every 2 seconds. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Casting plants a 1.3 m ice mirror for 1.6 seconds. It catches one enemy shot and sends a cold needle back to its living shooter: 8% of base hit as cold and 15 chill before gear. No child attacks. At most one mirror every 3 seconds. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Hit a chilled enemy to recover 0.35 seconds of your longest remaining movement-skill cooldown. It cannot bank time or reset an attack. One recovery per cast, at most every 2 seconds. Adds 35 chill buildup to the main hit.

Smoulder evolved by Ember: the first enemy struck by a cast anchors three fire/cold steam pulses, 0.8 seconds apart, in a 1.7 m patch. Each pulse has 6% of base hit damage before its own fire/cold gear scaling. Replaces this route's slowing Smoulder and Kindling; retains 40 ignite and 20 chill buildup. Pulses create no child effects.

classes.design_purpose: The projectile class: Volley fans a column's projectile skill out, Quarry sends every projectile through one more enemy and leaves the ones it passes bleeding. Both want Reach and Edge in lines, so a Ranger's plate is drawn toward long straight runs.

The standing class: Shield Wall makes armour answer fire and cold, Riposte makes the Barbs answer twice as hard and stagger. Both want Plate, Vigour and Edge in lines with a Vanguard resting among them.
The fire class: Pyre spreads every ignite on the hit rather than the death, Ashen Step makes burning ground yours. Both want Ember in lines, with Haste at the far end of one.

specialisations.design_purpose: The Ranger who goes through: the Volley's fan pierces, the Quarry pierces twice and cuts deeper.
The Ranger who multiplies: the Volley's bolts fork again, the Quarry's wounds are the mark the next bolt hits harder.
The Warden who is a wall: more armour behind the Shield Wall, and the Riposte reaching everything near you.
The Warden who holds ground: the Shield Wall rewards standing still, the Riposte staggers longer and quickens you after.
The Kindler who burns everything: the Pyre spreads at full strength on the hit, the ground heals more and the Dash goes further across it.
The Kindler who tends the fire: every fire skill lights faster, and every heal is more.

The rule speaks to the projectile skill in the column alone; the Reaches keep their plain readings. minimum_placed is one, not the usual two, because in era one a socket's column has a single free cell - the socket itself is the commitment.

patterns.design_purpose: A manner (D-020, D-022): a rail the world teaches rather than the class. After twelve hounds have fallen the pack's own habit - running you down - is yours to punish. Any class may set it; it competes with the class's patterns for the rails.

patterns.rule_text: standing still for a second grants 16 armour until you move
patterns.design_purpose: The husk's manner: it stands and it takes it. After eight have fallen, so can you. A flat integer on the sheet the engine grants after a second of stillness and takes back on the first step.

rails.design_purpose: RAILS (D-023 slice 9; owner, 4 Sep 2026): 'before you actually begin the game you choose a class, and in era 1 you can still access the plate/foundry, so that base plate's surrounding modifiers are determined by that first selection. Then once you complete trials you specialise further, getting a view of what the surround modifiers can become.' So: a CLASS is chosen before play begins (D-004) and its two PATTERNS are the plate's surround from era one. Each row and each column has one RAIL outside the grid; a pattern set in a rail names an axis, a condition on the line's PLACED cells (an empty cell never breaks a rail; minimum_placed keeps a lone ingot from lighting one, except Volley, whose socket is the commitment) and the rule it bends while the condition holds. by_era caps how many rails may be set (one in era one, two in era two, three in era three); one rail per pattern; set and cleared in the panel for free. Passing the first trial (the Tyrant's forge; specialise_on_world_effect) offers a one-time SPECIALISATION from the class's two: each says what every class pattern BECOMES (`becomes`), the panel shows the view before the choice, and a rail already holding the base pattern becomes the grown one. A grown pattern (`from`) inherits its base's axis and condition and changes only the rule. A rule speaks to the line's skills (a non-self modifier), to every skill with a tag (an effect's skill_tag) or to the sheet (a self modifier). MANNERS are patterns the world teaches: after taught_by.kills of that family have fallen the pattern is known to any class. Rails carry integers and flat numbers; the numbers never change, the lines do.

ingots.design_purpose: Beside a fire skill: +24% fire damage for it (value x support_multiplier), the one-lane support that is strongest early. Beside any other skill (owner, 4 Sep 2026: every ingot reads every skill): adds 24% of the hit as a fire packet of its own, scaled by fire gear - a cold-and-fire orb, the start of a scald build.
Beside a cold skill: +24% cold damage for it. Beside any other skill: adds 24% of the hit as cold, its own packet - a fire-and-cold bolt heading for quench, a strike that carries cold toward rime.
Beside a physical skill: +24% physical damage for it. Beside a spell: adds 24% of the hit as physical, its own packet - an orb with a physical edge, the start of brittle.

Reach's base is area size on the sheet; beside a skill it speaks the 'reach' modifier instead (owner, 4 Sep 2026: Reach reads area, projectile and strike skills): a wider area, a further-flying projectile, a longer strike.
Vigour's base is life on the sheet. Beside a skill it reads weakly (D-023 slice 2): a kill with that skill restores skill_value x support_multiplier life (1). The Catalyst's Reap sharpens it later.

Plate's base is armour on the sheet. Beside a skill it reads weakly: casting that skill grants skill_value x support_multiplier armour (4) for cast_armour_seconds. The Catalyst's Bracing sharpens it later.

Ward's base is fire resistance on the sheet. Beside a skill it reads weakly: an enemy carrying that skill's status (the chill, burn or bleed it applies) deals skill_value x support_multiplier less to you (5%). Inert beside a skill that applies no status until something gives it one. The Catalyst's Aegis sharpens it later.
Beside any attack or spell: +16% cooldown recovery for it (value x support_multiplier). Its base is the same on the sheet for every attack and spell.

sources.design_purpose: Rarity from the other end: the first elite hound pays a Haste already cast in the era's alloy - bronze in era two, steel in era three. The engine raises elite_kill for a kill that carried an elite modifier.
The first elite husk pays a Plate in the era's alloy: a wide-reaching backing for a Warden's wall.
The first elite hollow knight pays a Ward in steel.
The deeper forge's completion (the Ash Warden) pays a Frost in steel: a trial floor paying an ingot already cast in alloy.
D-021: the first time a combat skill works the world (a heavy blow drives the wedge) is a milestone - the click that the ARPG half and the sandbox half are one game pays an ingot.
The first dressed block (D-021) is a milestone: a Plate ingot, so the yard pays into the Foundry as the bench and the forge do.

design_purpose: D-025: the Foundry is the point system, built from owned milestone ingots, learned skill tablets and typed Kinds. Iron direct supports give straightforward additions; exact Kind paths supply early mechanical identity. Bronze/steel add richer direct refinements. Frame rows, sockets, costs, sources, class rails and shared-support links retain their existing contracts. This table contains the complete 96 base Kind/ingot forms, 16 alloy refinements and 16 ordered-pair additions. Mutation limits bound runtime operations; current equipment scales acquired tags while damage packets retain their native type. See docs/systems/foundry-mutations.md for stacking, compatibility and save contracts.
design_purpose_forms: FORMS (D-023, the flow): what a kind of a family works a support into. Keyed by family and ingot; `lane` narrows to how the ingot reads the skill (same element sharpens, added element reacts), `skill_tag` to the skill's tags. Each effect names a modifier, a value and, for a reaction, the packet it speaks to ('native' = the skill's own element). The ingot keeps its plain reading; the form's effects feed the skill the support serves. The Catalyst rows are the spec's reactions, their hook halves now engine hooks reading sim numbers (Echo, Quench, Rime, Sear, Brittle; Arc and Linger still wait); the Vanguard rows are proposals drafted from the owner's two examples (Frost Leech, Max Speed) and slice 4's readings. The Marrow rows are sustain twists and the Quicksilver rows tempo twists (slice 8): the spec's readings where a hook existed or was cheap, proposals where it did not; the Dash forms land on the sheet (the Dash is no skill on the plate) and the rest feed the skill. Compound forms (a kind worked by another kind, an ingot's metal or rarity as a condition) are the next step and have no rows yet.

links.design_purpose: LINKS (D-023, re-homed to the flow, 4 Sep 2026): a kind of this family resting in a corner that touches a support serving two sockets links the two skills laid there. When one skill's payload crosses a status threshold on an enemy - a freeze, an ignite, a bleed - the other casts itself at that enemy, with its own supports and its own cooldown, whether or not it sits on the bar; a link runs both ways, each skill on its own trigger. A linked cast never fires another link (the engine's depth guard). The kind still works the shared support into a form: the link is what the corner between two workings does on top. The link costs a Catalyst and that corner.

a cast or positive hit can seed only one of each operation. identity_tempo_window_seconds: Seconds a tempo footwork, combo or memory opportunity stays available; repeated input cannot refresh an unspent opportunity. identity_tempo_spacing: Planar metres required to leave a footprint or distinguish the three attack casting positions. identity_tempo_far_distance: Minimum planar metres from the old cast anchor for Long Wake's later positive contact. identity_tempo_target_range: Maximum clear distance for Long Wake's pull and Iron Wake's attacker response. identity_tempo_radius: Base radius of small tempo bursts before area and reach investment. identity_tempo_footprint_radius: Base radius for the abandoned Frost Wake footprint before area and reach investment. identity_tempo_line_half_width: Base half-width of the fire seam and two physical line cuts before area and reach investment. identity_tempo_line_max: Maximum authored length of a movement seam or contact-to-contact line; return cuts retain only the near six metres. identity_tempo_seam_seconds: Maximum time a drawn Cinder Wake seam waits for each crossing enemy; one packet per enemy and no pulse. identity_tempo_echo_delay_seconds: Visible delay before spell contact marks discharge and the old-position projectile screen becomes active. identity_tempo_ring_outer: Base outer radius of Wide Echo before area and reach investment. identity_tempo_ring_inner: Base safe inner radius of Wide Echo before area and reach investment; the echo does not hit its centre. identity_tempo_double_min_seconds: Earliest second positive contact that earns Doublecut; very rapid or repeated callbacks cannot collect it. identity_tempo_double_max_seconds: Latest second positive contact that earns Doublecut; waiting loses the timing opportunity. identity_tempo_brace_seconds: Stationary seconds required between Braced Refrain hits or after a Braced Echo cast. identity_tempo_armour_seconds: Seconds the earned personal armour lasts; it shares the strongest existing personal cast-armour pool. identity_tempo_still_distance: Planar metres of movement that breaks the two bracing opportunities. identity_tempo_orbit_range: Maximum distance to the marked Razor Wake enemy while completing the flank. identity_tempo_orbit_dot: Positive dot magnitude required beyond the marked enemy's flank; the opposite-side test compares against its negative value. identity_tempo_behind_offset: Metres behind the repeatedly struck burning enemy where Cinder Refrain's excluded-target burst is centred. identity_tempo_sequence_count: Separate real casts or positive-hit casts required for the two three-step attack sequences. identity_tempo_metronome_radius: Clear distance in metres at which a new spell can meet Aftercast's moving metronome. identity_tempo_metronome_wait_seconds: Seconds before the metronome starts moving and can reward a follow-up spell. identity_tempo_metronome_speed: Metres per second the metronome drifts along the original spell facing. identity_tempo_metronome_distance: Maximum metres the metronome moves from the original spell position. identity_tempo_mote_speed: Metres per second for returning chill and life motes; no status or healing before arrival. identity_tempo_mote_arrival: Metres from its recipient at which a returning mote pays its one status or healing budget. identity_tempo_boss_control_factor: Boss fraction of the two tempo pushes and the reactive attack stagger; native chill uses its separate existing boss rules. identity_tempo_screen_radius: Base sphere radius of Warded Echo's delayed one-shot interception screen before area and reach investment. identity_tempo_mark_radius: Metres of the compact tempo opportunity marker; it has no collision or gameplay reach. identity_tempo_echo_mark_ratio: Inner visual marker size for Afterimage's paired rings; purely distinguishes the stored echo from footprints. identity_tempo_line_height: Maximum vertical reach above a line cut; ordinary torso height is included while creatures on another floor remain excluded. identity_tempo_ground_probe_depth: Maximum metres below a drawn fire seam endpoint to find supporting ground; no terrain or collider is changed. identity_tempo_ground_offset: Metres the visible fire seam rests above supporting ground to prevent depth flicker. identity_guard_ring_height_ratio: Flattens only the defensive ring mesh so its growing radius does not form a thick band across first-person aim; interception size is unchanged. identity_guard_ring_opacity: Opacity of defensive ring marks; the environment and enemies remain visible through their body-height plane.
